study.title: Transferring learned patterns from ground-based field imagery to predict UAV-based imagery for crop and weed semantic segmentation in precision crop farming
study.short_title: Transferring Field-Trained Patterns to UAV Imagery (Crop/Weed Segmentation)

segmentation.best_model: Proposed network (SegNet-type encoder, trained on field images)

dataset.name: UAV orthomosaic imagery of a maize field (different field than training; 3-4 true-leaf stage)
dataset.note: Test/domain imagery: Sony Alpha 6000 camera on Hydra-12 Onyxstar (Mikrokopter) UAV at 20 m altitude; GSD 1.78 mm/pixel; evaluated on a UAV orthomosaic of a maize field different from training fields (3-4 true-leaf stage) with manual ground truth map; network trained ONLY on ground-based field images (Nikon D7200, ~1 m above ground, >10,000 images from four Belgian maize fields, resized 1200x800 then cropped to 5000 512x512 training tiles + 621 validation) and applied to lower-resolution UAV imagery. Classes: soil background, weed, crop (maize); weighted loss (weed 2.5, crop 1.5, soil 1) + fully connected CRF post-processing.

mIoU.quote: The proposed network (0.617), UNet (0.601) and SegNet (0.609) achieved better mIOU values than the FCN family with the best mIOU (0.538) achieved by FCN8. The proposed network works best among other networks.
mIoU.ambiguity: mIOU 0.617 of the proposed network evaluated on UAV orthomosaic imagery (per-class IoU: soil 0.815, weed 0.441, crop 0.596).

mPA.ambiguity: mOA (mean pixel accuracy) 0.734 for proposed network on UAV orthomosaic imagery.

PA.ambiguity: Per-class OA reported in Table 3; overall pixel accuracy not separately summarized.

weed_F1.ambiguity: Only per-class IoU (weed 0.441) and OA (weed 0.582) reported, not F1.

crop_F1.ambiguity: Only per-class IoU (crop 0.596) and OA (crop 0.689) reported, not F1.

edge.device: None - offline (trained with 4x NVIDIA Tesla P100-SXM2, 16 GB; no edge deployment)
edge.framework: TensorFlow (Adam optimizer, initial lr 0.005, batch size 24)

params_M.quote: There are 42,037,391 parameters in total with 42,018,441 trainable parameters and 18,950 non-trainable parameters.
params_M.ambiguity: Model structural parameter count of the proposed network (not an edge deployment).
